observed.symptom: Composio connections labeled for Bedrijfsgeheugen resolved to Instagram username arthurprinsen and could still pass connection-level checks.
observed.root_cause: Connection aliases and ACTIVE/BUSINESS status were treated as sufficient identity evidence, while the runtime could also fall back to Meta direct or Buffer. Provider username was not a hard pre-side-effect invariant.
evidence: Composio INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO returned username arthurprinsen for the canonical alias.
Meta Business Suite shows @bedrijfsgeheugen.nl exists and is assigned to the Bedrijfsgeheugen business portfolio.

prevention: Require provider username bedrijfsgeheugen.nl before capability consumption or provider mutation.
Bind the numeric provider Instagram user id explicitly to create/publish calls.
Never infer identity from Composio alias, default status, Business account type, or Meta asset membership.
Wrong/missing identity is recoverable and cannot trigger Buffer, Make, direct-Meta fallback, regeneration, or replacement publication.
verification: CI asserts canonical username gate and explicit ig_user_id binding.
CI asserts Instagram transport contract is instagram-composio-only-canonical-identity-v1.
Production readback must show provider=composio, buffer_dependency=false, meta_direct_dependency=false and canonical Instagram identity.
